request: Derek, 2026-09-23: "Since Mark2 is loaded up with white pet-gf still on a 0.04 nozzle on the right side, I'd like to do a quick run of the tap and flavor bulkhead collars there first before we do the larger prints."

settings_departures_from_petgf_3mf.layer_height: 0.2: ten layers make the 2.0 mm chip and put the word's 1.0 mm floor on a layer boundary
settings_departures_from_petgf_3mf.bottom_shell_layers: 5: the chip prints solid, a washer the fitting's nut clamps

review: Every layer carries both hotends: the TAP chip on the right (white), the FLAVOR chips on the left (black).

The words fill layers 1.2-2.0: TAP on the left hotend (black), FLAVOR on the right (white); the top layer's toolpaths read the words turned 180 degrees on the bed, not mirrored (layers-by-hotend.png).
No support, no sparse infill, no bridge; objects 96.5-233.5 x 106.4-143.6 mm, inside both hotends' shared area; prime tower at the profile's 165, 250.
